Specification: This module defines a very small specification centered on a single variable v and a helper operator ChooseOne that uses a CHOOSE expression over a set. The helper selects an element x from a set S satisfying P(x) together with a universal condition over all y in S, and the specification initializes v to the chosen value from the singleton set {1} using a lambda predicate that returns TRUE. The temporal behavior then requires that v remain unchanged forever via the boxed stuttering formula [][UNCHANGED v]_v. The model has no fault model, no fairness assumptions, and no proofs; it mainly illustrates choice, quantification, lambda abstraction, and a simple temporal specification.
ChoiceExpr: CHOOSE x \in S : P(x) /\ \A y \in S : P(y)
